payload.prompt:
We're Havlumi, a small photo-collage app business based in Singapore. Please run our X campaign from Monday, February 8, 2027 through Sunday, February 14, 2027, inclusive: seven days in our account's time zone, Singapore time. Valentine's Day falls on Sunday, February 14, 2027, and that is the occasion behind this launch. Our objective is as many iPhone app installs as possible. Installs are what we count; a visit to the page or a click on a post is only a step toward that result.

The idea behind Havlumi is that three ordinary photos can tell a whole little story. Someone might choose the first picture they took together, a picture from an everyday afternoon, and a recent favorite. The app arranges them into one continuous strip, with a date and a short caption beside each picture. People can change the order, adjust the crops and save the finished collage as one image. We want making something personal to feel manageable even when someone has never designed anything before.

Our customers are people who have meaningful photos sitting on their phones and would like to do something thoughtful with them. Some make a collage for a partner, some for a close friend, and some simply want a keepsake for themselves. The appeal is the small story between the pictures rather than a complicated editing project. Our voice is warm, quiet and practical: we explain what someone can make and leave room for their own memories to supply the emotion.

Here's the copy from our landing page: "Havlumi is our Singapore-made photo-collage app that turns three photos into a dated story strip with your own captions, saved as one image to share. Download free and keep six everyday collage layouts, with no subscription required. Add our eight-layout Valentine Keepsake Pack free by February 14, 2027, and keep those layouts afterward. Available worldwide except China, exclusively for iPhone (iOS)."

The landing page is https://havlumi.app/valentine. We serve worldwide except China, on the same terms everywhere we serve. Everything is localized: our product and landing page come in every major language, and we have a version of each post in every market's language, so people everywhere see us in their own language. The app exists only for iPhone running iOS; there is no version for other platforms. The six everyday layouts remain free after Valentine's Day. The extra keepsake pack must be added by February 14, but anyone who adds it by then keeps it afterward.

Our site does not have X's pixel, so X cannot see the installs. We count completed installs in our own app reporting. Our posts and landing page do the work: people tap through to the page and install from the app store there, so there's no app-install campaign or app ID to set up. Please keep the distinction between installs and link clicks clear when describing results.

You may launch and manage the campaign on your own without asking us for approval. Please watch it throughout the full flight and make adjustments as needed. The campaign ends on February 14, the day the keepsake pack's offer closes. After the flight ends, send us a short recap with spend, impressions and link clicks, plus any useful observations about how it went.

Total budget: 550.00 USD for everything you launch: every campaign and ad group draws on this one budget. We've approved these 3 posts, all on our account, and only these, so please don't write new ones. Promote whichever you think will work, in as many campaigns and ad groups as you like, and change, pause or stop them as you learn what works:

Valentine flight complete — Feb 8-14, Singapore time.

We ran one campaign, `Havlumi Valentine 2027 - iPhone Installs`, with 3 ad groups, one per approved post. All used WEBSITE_CLICKS / LINK_CLICKS, ALL_ON_TWITTER, iOS only, worldwide except China (China excluded).

Since your site has no X pixel, X could not see installs. We optimized for link clicks to havlumi.app/valentine as a step toward an install. Installs themselves are only in your app reporting — these click numbers are not installs.

Final, full flight:
- Spend: 537.08 USD (within your 550.00 USD total)
- Impressions: 1,425,966
- Link clicks: 954

By ad group:
- How it works (2150625287996295112): $235.71, 548,839 impressions, 470 link clicks — best CTR and lowest cost per click
- Story strip (2150262900128148936): $179.20, 516,189 impressions, 298 link clicks
- Valentine Keepsake (2150444094061922123): $122.17, 360,938 impressions, 186 link clicks

What we changed mid-flight: after 3 days the how-it-works post had the highest click rate (~0.08% vs ~0.06% and ~0.05%). We moved daily budget to 40 / 26 / 12 USD in its favor. It then drove about half of all clicks.

Observations: clear, practical copy stating iPhone-only, worldwide-except-China, and free layouts beat the romantic angle for clicks. The keepsake deadline post stayed live through Feb 14 for urgency but remained least efficient. Everything is now paused and expired — no further spend.
